task.instruction: original task instruction; hash is in frozen identity

sampling_config.container_scope: agent container cgroup and its child processes
counters: cumulative CPU and interval average cores
memory.current and kernel memory peak separately
cgroup disk I/O cumulative bytes and valid interval rates
per-interface bytes in the container network namespace

python_wiring.login_shell: /etc/profile restores venv PATH after its system PATH reset
python_wiring.codex_tools: DockerCliRuntime executes bash -lc; login-shell equivalence validated offline

approval: separate explicit approval required; no APPROVAL/ATTEMPT/raw created

render_adaptation.overlay: project-owned derivative copied into /opt/video-use and exposed through the registered skill symlink
render_adaptation.preserve_source_spec: --preserve-source-spec disables hard-coded scaling and preserves the probed source rate
render_adaptation.production_command_contract: native render.py in the task image; synthetic tests invoke this same file
render_adaptation.timeline_boundary: timeline_view probes duration/frame rate and clamps sample timestamps to valid frames

verifier.judge: unmodified official judge.py; hash-checked before invocation
verifier.ffmpeg: host ffmpeg/ffprobe; versions frozen in verifier-environment.json
verifier.status_model: judge process rc, evaluation completeness/status, and task score are separate fields
verifier.oracle_validation: one isolated official-golden oracle chain check; never exposed to Agent

prompt_constraints.timestamp_semantics: transcript timestamps are candidate regions only; Agent determines both cut boundaries
